## Similar archetypes

Solkael/Brumgar/Rhazgor share defensive mass: distinguish gauntlet counter, rounded fist sustain and shield/horn siege. Kitsara/Lupika share agility: daggers and deceptive pivots versus heel strikes and spring steps. Aethryon/Oromir/Morvayne share casting: spear-line charge, clock-ring control and rapier sigils. Sylvex/Skarvex share Toxin: coiled mist attrition versus overhead stinger puncture. Do not solve overlap by changing stats in this phase.
